notes: Deadline for this programme without a stated year (15 October – 1 December) is recorded as recurringDeadline; the general DIT summer-semester deadline table gives "15 Oct - 28 Feb" for this programme, but no year is stated. Tuition: the DAAD listing quotes '500 EUR' per semester for non-EU applicants and the DIT fees page quotes a '€500 DIT service fee per semester' for non-EU/EEA third-country students; recorded as 50000 EUR minor per semester. An additional €60 one-time application fee and a student union fee apply. The programme page states 'No tuition fees, only student union fee', which conflicts with the DAAD and fees pages; the human auditor should verify. Application channel: the programme page's "APPLY ONLINE" link and the general DIT page describe application via the university's own Primuss portal, so de-university-direct is used; no uni-assist/VPD sentence was found for this programme. Documents list comes from the international-applicant section of the general DIT application page; the exact programme-specific list is generated in Primuss.
